CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.user_can_manage_judges(p_show_id uuid, p_user_id uuid DEFAULT NULL::uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
  select public.user_can_manage_show(
    p_show_id,
    coalesce(p_user_id, auth.uid())
  );
$function$
